'''Alex Richetta''' won the [[May 2003 Rochester, Minnesota tournament]] on 17 May 2003, a 12-player constructed tournament at Face the Music, and collected a $5.00 cash bounty on [[Joshua Grace|Josh Grace]] there.<ref name="pcf-1291-26390">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=26390#26390 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
